description: Changes the light, the camera or the look of one of the user's photos, paid from their credits: at most one pick per group (light, lens, angle, focus, look), and/or text, up to 300 characters of what to change. What is not picked stays as it is. light and look keep the pose, framing and scene; a lens, angle or focus pick re-imagines the same moment through that camera, so the framing changes. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits: the photo's prices from get_shoot or list_photos name it. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.
name: light_camera
title: Relight a photo, or see it through another camera
